data.title: 伽玛 · 祭典夜市的巡店
data.description: 夏日祭的夜市里，伽玛穿着牡丹浴衣慢慢巡视四越商会的连排摊位。灯笼的光映在她脸上，摊主们纷纷挺直腰板——会长来查账了。
data.location: summer festival night market street lined with lantern-lit stalls of a trading company
data.action: 穿着牡丹浴衣慢慢巡视四越商会的连排摊位，灯笼的光映在她脸上
data.lighting: 夜市灯笼的暖橙光与远处烟火的闪光
data.promptProse: Strolling unhurriedly down a lively summer festival street lined with Mitsugoshi trading stalls, Gamma wears her deep indigo peony yukata and gold obi with serene aristocratic grace. Holding a slim ledger lightly in one hand, she inspects each bustling booth with a warm yet discerning smile while distant fireworks blossom across the night sky. Rows of glowing orange paper lanterns bathe her composed face and the colorful wooden stalls in rich festival light.
data.animaCaption: Strolling along the lantern-lit summer festival street in her indigo peony yukata, Gamma holds a slim ledger and inspects the busy Mitsugoshi stalls with a composed smile. Warm orange lanterns and distant night fireworks glow across the lively market.
